MATCH (a:Issue)-[r:BLOCKER|DEPENDS|DUPLICATE|SUPERSESSION]->(b:Issue)
WITH r, CASE WHEN type(r)='SUPERSESSION' THEN b ELSE a END AS s, CASE WHEN type(r)='SUPERSESSION' THEN a ELSE b END AS t
MATCH (s)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(sp:Person), (t)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(tp:Person)
WHERE sp<>tp
WITH r, s, t, sp, tp
UNWIND [[s.issueKey, sp.personKey],[t.issueKey, tp.personKey]] AS x
RETURN DISTINCT x[0] AS issue, r.linkId AS link, x[1] AS person, sp.personKey AS id

MATCH (a:Issue)-[r:BLOCKER|DEPENDS|DUPLICATE|SUPERSESSION]->(b:Issue)
WITH r, CASE WHEN type(r)='SUPERSESSION' THEN b ELSE a END AS s, CASE WHEN type(r)='SUPERSESSION' THEN a ELSE b END AS t
MATCH (s)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(sp:Person), (t)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(tp:Person)
WHERE sp<>tp
RETURN DISTINCT sp.personKey AS id
